verdict.rationale: Supabase documents branching as separate environments, with isolated preview environments per pull request, for testing database schema changes without touching production. Its official MCP server gives agents `create_branch`, `merge_branch`, `reset_branch` and `rebase_branch` alongside `apply_migration`, and the MCP security guidance names branching as the safe place to test changes before merging. Missing for 10: the MCP branching tools are labeled experimental, and there is no hands-on or independent corroboration of an agent completing the branch-test-merge workflow end to end.
